entries.name: Lantern Watcher
entries: You have kept watch through many long nights.

entries.name: Steady Light
entries: While you hold a lit lantern, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made at night.

feat:lantern-watcher.name: 守燈人
entries: 你曾守過許多漫長的夜。

entries.name: 穩定的光
entries: 你手持點亮的提燈時，夜間進行的感知（察覺）檢定具有優勢。
At our table, the light this spell makes is the warm yellow of a lantern flame. Otherwise the spell works as written.
在我們這桌，這道法術發出的光是提燈火焰那種溫暖的黃光；其餘照原本的規則運作。
